description: Convert the src/link/Elf/* cluster (the linker's object/symbol/section/version/atom files) to the typed model. Depends on FEAT-001 (Elf.sig core types + plumbing must land first). This covers spec steps 2-5: the Sym cluster, Object cluster, synthetic_sections (Verneed/Vernaux/Verdef), SharedObject/eh_frame/Atom, plus the small remaining link/Elf/* consumers and the 3 genuine ELF hits in src/link/Dwarf.sig. INCLUDES the Atom.sig reloc build site which is part of RISKIEST SPOT #3 (reloc bitfield packing).
steps: Read A1-migration-spec.md steps 2-5 and plan.md; apply the name->member mapping to each file. Gate after EACH file (the compiler surfaces one unit at a time).

Sym cluster: src/link/Elf/Symbol.sig, src/link/Elf/file.sig, src/link/Elf/LinkerDefined.sig — Sym fields (st_*->info/other/name/value/size/shndx, st_type()->info.type, st_bind()->info.bind), Shdr fields, and STB_*/STT_*/SHT_* const refs.

Object cluster: src/link/Elf/Object.sig, src/link/Elf/ZigObject.sig, src/link/Elf/relocatable.sig — Shdr/Sym/Rela fields, underscore type tokens (Elf64_* -> Elf64.*), consts; ZigObject.relocs + RelocsIterator store []Elf64.Rela and their reloc reads become info.type/info.sym/offset/addend.

src/link/Elf/synthetic_sections.sig — rename Elf64_Verneed/Vernaux/Verdef type tokens to Elf64.* and vn_version/vn_cnt/vn_file/vn_aux/vn_next -> version/cnt/file/aux/next; convert field accesses + consts.

src/link/Elf/SharedObject.sig — Verdef/Verdaux pointer-walk via bytesAsValue: keep byte layout identical, only rename field reads; eh_frame.sig and Atom.sig: convert reloc reads rel.r_type()->rel.info.type, rel.r_sym()->rel.info.sym, rel.r_offset->rel.offset, rel.r_addend->rel.addend.

RISKIEST SPOT #3 (Atom.sig build site ~255-257): convert `.{ .r_offset=O, .r_info=(@as(u64,sym)<<32)|rtype, .r_addend=A }` to `.{ .offset=O, .info = .{ .type=@intCast(rtypeU32), .sym=@intCast(symIdxU32) }, .addend=A }`. Elf64.Rel.Info is packed struct(u64){type:u32,sym:u32} — type is LOW 32, sym is HIGH 32 (bit-identical to old shift). Do NOT swap the field order.
Remaining small consumers: src/link/Elf/gc.sig, src/link/Elf/AtomList.sig, src/link/Elf/Thunk.sig, src/link/Elf/Merge.sig.

src/link/Dwarf.sig: convert ONLY the genuine ELF hits at lines ~497 (shdr.sh_offset), ~498 (shdr.sh_size), ~1091 (shdrs.items[shndx].sh_addr). LEAVE lines ~4193/4207 (.sh_renesas/.sh_interrupt — SuperH, NOT ELF). Do NOT touch src/link/Dwarf2.sig (all SuperH false positives).
acceptance_criteria: gate.ps1 prints GATE: GREEN after the cluster is converted.
src/link/Dwarf.sig has no genuine ELF .sh_* hits remaining (lines 497/498/1091 converted); the SuperH tags are untouched.
verification: Run the 3-layer gate; confirm GATE: GREEN.
findings:
FEAT-002 complete. All 14 src/link/Elf/* cluster files + src/link/Dwarf.sig (lines 497/498/1091) migrated to the typed ELF model. Both acceptance rg checks are ZERO: (1) `rg -g "*.sig" "Elf(32|64)_[A-Za-z]|elf\.(SHT|SHF|STB|STT|STV|ELFCLASS|ELFDATA|EI)_[A-Z]|\.(sh_|st_info|st_other|st_shndx|st_value|st_name|r_info|r_addend|d_tag|d_val)" src/link/Elf` -> 0; (2) Dwarf.sig has no genuine `.sh_offset/.sh_size/.sh_addr` (converted to .offset/.size/.addr). SuperH `.sh_renesas`/`.sh_interrupt` at Dwarf.sig 4193/4207 left untouched. Dwarf2.sig not touched.

GATE: layers 2 (`sig test lib/std/elf.sig` -> All 0 tests passed) and 3 (`sig test lib/std/dynamic_library.sig` -> 2 skipped, 0 failed) are GREEN. Layer 1 (full compiler graph) now has ZERO errors originating in any FEAT-002 file, Dwarf.sig, or Elf.sig; the ONLY remaining graph-red is in FEAT-004-owned codegen reloc-literal sites: src/codegen/aarch64/Mir.sig, src/codegen/riscv64/Emit.sig, src/codegen/x86_64/Emit.sig (and loongarch/Mir.sig) still building `.{ .r_offset=.., .r_info=.., .r_addend=.. }` on the renamed Elf64.Rela. Those are RISKIEST SPOT #3's codegen half and are explicitly FEAT-004's scope (plan.md step 8c), so they were NOT touched here. Full-graph green arrives once FEAT-004 lands (same per-file-gate precedent as FEAT-001).

RISKIEST SPOT #3 (Atom.sig build site): converted `.{ .r_offset=O, .r_info=(@as(u64,sym)<<32)|rtype, .r_addend=A }` -> `.{ .offset=O, .addend=A, .info = .{ .type=r_type, .sym=@intCast(r_sym) } }` where r_type is already u32 from rel.info.type. Elf64.Rel.Info is packed struct(u64){type:u32 LOW, sym:u32 HIGH} = bit-identical to old shift. Same conversion applied to ZigObject.sig (10 reloc builds incl. dwarf cross-reloc + getNavVAddr/getUavVAddr), Object.sig (resolveMergeSubsections rel.info rewrite), eh_frame.sig (emitReloc), synthetic_sections.sig (PltSection.addRela).

CROSS-FILE NOTES for later features:
- Symbol.sig `elfSym()` now returns `elf.Elf64.Sym` and `Symbol.type()` now returns `elf.STT` (was u4). Callers compare against `elf.STT.FUNC/.SECTION/.TLS/.GNU_IFUNC` (enum), updated in Atom/Object/eh_frame.
- Symbol.setOutputSym `out: *elf.Elf64.Sym`; writes `.info = .{.bind=STB,.type=STT}`, `.other = .{.visibility=STV}`.
- LinkerDefined/Object/ZigObject/SharedObject symtab buffers now store `elf.Elf64.Sym`; `Elf.null_sym`/`elf_file.symtab` were ALREADY `Elf64.Sym` (FEAT-001). SharedObject.Parsed.{sections:[]Elf64.Shdr, symtab:[]Elf64.Sym} and Header.{dynamic_table:[]Elf64.Dyn, sections:[]Elf64.Shdr} migrated -> this forced two consequential edits in src/link/Elf.sig: parseDso `esym.st_value`->`esym.value` (~1173), and the pre-existing FEAT-001 bug `args_type == .X86_64_UNWIND` (decl-literal doesn't resolve for `==`) -> `args_type == elf.SHT.X86_64_UNWIND` (~1378). X86_64_UNWIND/LLVM_ADDRSIG/GNU_* are `pub const` SHT members (via @fromBackingInt), NOT enum tags, so they need full `elf.SHT.X` qualification in `==`/`!=` comparisons; enum-literal `.X` shorthand works only for genuine tags (DYNSYM/DYNAMIC/RELA/SYMTAB/NOBITS/GROUP/NOTE/PREINIT_ARRAY/INIT_ARRAY/FINI_ARRAY/NULL/STRTAB/SYMTAB_SHNDX).
- PLUMBING: AddSectionOpts/initOutputSection/getOrCreateMergeSection stay INT (type:u32, flags:u64) per FEAT-001. Consumers in Object.sig/ZigObject.sig now pass `@intFromEnum(shdr.type)` and `@as(u64, @bitCast(shdr.flags))` (shdr.flags is packed struct(Xword)=u64 so a direct @bitCast) OR for literals `@as(u64, @as(elf.Word, @bitCast(elf.SHF{...})))` (SHF is packed struct(Word)=u32, must widen through elf.Word first -- a naked `@as(u64,@bitCast(SHF))` is a size-mismatch @compileError). Merge.Section keeps type:u32/flags:u64.
- Shdr.flags full-value assigns use `shdr.flags = .{ .shf = .{ .ALLOC=true, ... } }`; reads use `shdr.flags.shf.ALLOC/.WRITE/.EXECINSTR/.TLS/.MERGE/.STRINGS/.COMPRESSED/.INFO_LINK`. SHF_GNU_RETAIN -> `.flags.shf.OS.GNU.RETAIN`; SHF_EXCLUDE -> `.flags.shf.PROC.X86_64.EXCLUDE` (both bit-position-identical regardless of union variant).
- Object.sig: renamed a local `sh_entsize` var to `ent_size` to avoid the acceptance regex false-positive on `[0..sh_entsize]`.
- NOT COMMITTED by this feature: lib/std/elf.sig and src/link/Lld.sig show as modified in the worktree but that is the pre-existing uncommitted "PROGRESS ALREADY DONE" (twins + Lld migration) from before FEAT-001; untouched here, left unstaged.
